the role of social and emotional intelligence in the classroom, specifically, the role of social intelligence in the classroom.
the role of emotional intelligence (EI) in the classroom and its relationship to academic performance and teacher effectiveness.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
emotional intelligence in the classroom is an essential skill for teachers to develop in order to effectively teach and manage students in the classroom.
the incorporation of emotional intelligence training into the classroom can help to improve the social and emotional development of students and teachers.
social emotional programs are a valuable asset to any classroom, and can be implemented with the right training.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
emotional intelligence is the ability to recognize, understand and manage our own emotions, as well as the emotions of others.
the more social and emotional learning skills teachers and students have, the more likely they are to be successful.
the social and emotional skills taught in schools should be taught to all students, and should be taught by teachers who themselves are trained in these skills.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social and emotional learning is not just about the students, but also about the adults in their lives, and that the adults in their life have to model the behavior they are teaching.
social and emotional competence is a powerful tool for improving academic achievement, reducing conduct problems, and promoting healthy social development.
social and emotional learning should be integrated into the school curriculum.
